text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Like a diamond. With unbreakable strength, 
and the priceless radiance that remains 
untainted by anything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The crystallization of countless wishes 
and countless expectations. That is who I 
am—Satono Diamond—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother. Please, don't look so 
sorrowful anymore.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Dia is enrolling in her dream school, 
Tracen Academy, you know? Please send her 
off with a smile♪

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's right...! Take care of yourself, 
okay? Don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for your dream to come true.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I have only one dream: to fulfill the 
Satono family's long-cherished wish.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(To produce a legendary Umamusume capable 
of winning a G1. That is the Satono 
family's dearest wish. The very reason I 
was born.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The wishes of my family, who blessed my 
birth and placed their hopes in my 
success. —I want to make them come true.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will definitely achieve results in 
the Twinkle Series and prove myself as a 
legendary Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Dia will make our family's dream come 
true!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(—Finally... The time has finally 
come...!)

My challenge in the Twinkle Series 
alongside Satono Diamond had begun.

Now that the timing for her debut race was 
set, I came to the grounds to let her know 
right away, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You are set to debut in the Twinkle Series 
this year— how are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am overjoyed to be able to make my 
debut. I have waited so long for this 
moment.

Satono Diamond was surrounded by a crowd 
of reporters, giving interviews.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Did your parents or anyone from the Satono 
Group have any words of encouragement for 
your debut?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I received words of encouragement 
telling me to "give it your all."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What are your thoughts on getting the 
Satono Group's first GⅠ victory? I'm sure 
everyone has very high expectations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Winning a GⅠ race is naturally the 
goal for both myself and my family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but every Umamusume is aiming for 
victory, aren't they? I'll do my best so I 
won't lose to anyone either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Miss Satono is handling this very 
calmly, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She was already drawing quite a bit of 
attention before. Now that her debut is 
decided, it's hardly surprising that she's 
being flooded with press requests.

She is Mejiro McQueen. One of the 
Umamusume representing the prestigious 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's been interviewed several times 
before, so there shouldn't be any worries. 
How about you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As Satono-san's trainer, you will surely 
be asked for comment eventually. You best 
be prepared.

Her words left me feeling slightly dizzy. 
I was reminded once more of just what an 
incredible Umamusume I had taken on as a 
Trainer.

Out of reach—that's what I thought at 
first, too. Yet, Satono Diamond personally 
chose me, and I was able to become her 
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, sorry for the wait!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The interview is over!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen! You were here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Satono-san, congratulations on 
finalizing your debut.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much! Congratulations 
from you, McQueen-san... Ehehe, I'm so 
happy♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just like McQueen-san carrying the Mejiro 
name on her shoulders, I'll do my best as 
a Satono Umamusume too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I shall look forward to it. Well 
then, I will take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...McQueen-san, could it be you came to 
congratulate me...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Such gentle consideration, that's 
McQueen-san for you! The subtle way she 
does it is just wonderful!
choice_data_list:
Looks like they're expecting a lot from 
you.
Looks like they have high hopes for us.

text_block_list.text:
I've heard that Mejiro McQueen is the 
Umamusume Satono Diamond looks up to most. 
Receiving her congratulations must bring 
exceptional joy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I cannot show McQueen-san an embarrassing 
run. Let us begin our training right away!
choice_data_list:
Before that, your debut date has been 
decided!

Before that, your debut date has been 
decided!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really!? When? When is it!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*... How was my lap time?
choice_data_list:
I want to pick up the pace a bit in the 
first half.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"So I saved up too much stamina in my 
legs, huh... Let's do one more!"
You're really pumped up, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aren't you super motivated today?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The date for my debut has been decided!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm finally at the starting line...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!! We did it, we did it, we did it, 
Dia-chan!

Kitasan Black rejoices with immense 
delight. It seems the two made a promise 
in their childhood to 'run the Classic 
Triple Crown together.'

This was before I became Satono Diamond's 
Trainer. Last year, Kitasan Black had 
already made her debut ahead of her.

On the other hand, Satono Diamond 
reportedly showed no signs of her growth 
spurt beginning.

The Awakening... It is a period where an 
Umamusume's racing abilities grow 
dramatically. Without reaching it, she 
cannot expect to succeed even if she 
debuts.

Satono Diamond apparently chose to put off 
debuting in the same class as Kitasan 
Black and wait until her body fully 
matures.

And finally, Satono Diamond began her 
growth spurt, teamed up with me, and that 
brings us to the present.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Finally... I can finally chase after her! 
No more just watching Kita-chan's back as 
she runs ahead!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll chase after you at full speed and 
catch right up to you, Kita-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm not gonna get caught that 
easily! I'm running with everything I've 
got, too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm definitely going to catch up. 
I'll catch up, and then... I'll run with 
Kita-chan in a Twinkle Series race!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a promise!! If you're late, I'm 
leaving you behind!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, no need to worry. Right, Trainer?

Satono Diamond, the shining hope of the 
Satono family. Shouldering countless 
dreams and wishes, the days spent making 
her shine brighter than anyone began.
